name: Mahaana Wealth
all_locations: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan; Islamabad, Islamabad Capital Territory, Pakistan
long_description: Pakistan has 401K style schemes for retirement but only 0.02% people have retirement accounts. Previously unallowed, Digital onboarding & KYC was adopted by the regulator in late 2021. We are the first & only licensed digital investment advisor and looking to take advantage of this regulatory tailwind. We are now licensed to create our own retirement funds & ETFs just like Vanguard
one_liner: Mahaana is first & only licensed digital wealth manager in Pakistan

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Before starting his startup in Pakistan, Mahaana, Shamoon has been working as a Partner in a Swedish based Investment manager & ranked as top 3 global investment manager in Frontier markets space. He is a CFA and FDP charter holder.

news.title: YCombinator-backed Mahaana Wealth announces $2.1mn pre-seed raise to digitise wealth management in Pakistan - Profit by Pakistan Today
